# Synthetic high-entropy plaintext canaries for the P2-U7 transcript lane.
# Never use personal or production data here. Every string below is a made-up
# token that stands in for one field of an official transcript, so a scan of a
# profile can tell "this field never reached the disk in the clear" from "no
# scan ran". The `credits` field carries no canary: it is an exact decimal and a
# one-digit number would match everywhere.
